content.short: Muon Network is a chain-independent, stateless DON enabling dApps to decentralize their off-chain components.
content.description: Muon Network is a flexible, secure, and permissionless decentralized oracle platform that lets projects design and deploy their own oracle applications without being tied to a single use case. Its security rests on a three-component strategy that resists manipulation by centralized authorities, strengthening trust across the network. As a fully permissionless system, anyone can run nodes or operate apps, contributing to a decentralized, open ecosystem where participation and innovation are unhindered by gatekeepers.
